title: Popping Ripples
description: Emphasises the color- and alpha contrast on water
body:
This resource pack ads a high contrast to the color and transparency of water to give it a shader like look while maintaining it's vanilla feel. 

![water in motion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nZDjVTdX/images/68700c16ae19cd4f380a533eecbd3d8c7186ef91.gif)

Bucket textures that include water have also been edited.
